THIS CRIMINAL MISC. CASE HAVING BEEN FINALLY HEARD ON 03.12.2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY PASSED THE FOLLOWING:
 Crl.M.C No.10048 of 2025  2025:KER:93716  -3-  ORDER (Dated this the 3rd day of December, 2025)

The petitioner is the sole accused in S.C No.245 of 2024 pending before the Additional District and Sessions Court-II, Pathanamthitta, arising out of Crime No.250 of 2023 of Thiruvalla Police Station.

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Court-II, Pathanamthitta
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The offence alleged against the petitioner are under Sections 366, 376(2)(n), 354-D and 506(1) of IPC and Section 67-A of IT Act.

2. The prosecution case is that the accused, with an intention to satisfy his sexual lust, made friendship with the de facto complainant, and he committed rape upon her on one day in August 2021 at the newly constructed residence of the de facto complainant.
Thereafter, he allegedly committed rape upon her on 13.08.2021 and 31.10.2021, at a home stay at Alappuzha in different places.

3. According to the learned counsel for the petitioner, even if the entire allegations levelled against the petitioner are believed as such, the same will not constitute the offences alleged against the petitioner.
Further according to him, the matter has been settled between the de facto complainant.
Therefore, he prayed for quashing all further proceedings against the petitioner.
4. The petition was opposed by the learned Public Prosecutor.
5. On a perusal of the FI statement, it can be seen that the petitioner and the de facto complainant had sexual intercourse with each other at different places on different dates.

Though it is alleged that the first such incident was a forceful one from her conduct in accompanying the petitioner to different places on different dates and permitting him to have sexual intercourse with her shows that their relationship was a consensual one.
Moreover, the matter has been settled between the parties and, as such, no useful purpose will be served in continuing the proceedings against the petitioner further.
In the above circumstances, this Crl.M.C is allowed.

All further proceedings against the petitioner in S.C No.245 of 2024 pending before the Additional District and Sessions Court-II, Pathanamthitta,
